sections.heading: 把 Druid 的能力 带进 Rust 异步世界
sections.text: 保留连接池、SQL 分析与安全防护的核心思路，用 trait 组合和 tokio 重新实现。 Druid-Rust 把 Java 生态里久经考验的连接池、SQL 解析、防火墙与监控能力，重写成一套 Rust crate。没有 JVM，没有 DI 容器，也没有 ORM 包装：连接、SQL 与指标都以明确的结构体和 trait 暴露。 项目按职责拆成 10 个 crate，可以只引入 druid-pool 使用连接池，也可以把 druid-wall 与 druid-stat 挂进 Filter 链，一次获得安全与可观测性。 代码遵循 Apache-2.0。项目宠物与视觉资产版权归作者所有，商业使用需取得授权。 不是把 Java 类层级逐行翻译，而是保留问题本身，重选 Rust 的解法。 基于 tokio 的全链路异步 I/O，用 Semaphore 精确限制并发，驱逐与 KeepAlive 由后台任务驱动。 Java 的类继承体系改为 trait 与 struct 组合，Filter trait 提供完整生命周期钩子，默认空实现。 DbType 枚举穷举 30 种数据库方言，SQL 语句与表达式是代数数据类型，编译器检查完整性。 AOT 编译为原生二进制，PoolGuard 用 RAII 自动归还，无 JIT 预热，也没有运行时容器。 依赖单向向下，连接从创建到销毁的每一步都有明确归属。 每一层只承担一种职责，下层永远不需要知道上层存在。 axum HTTP 监控页面与 JSON 接口，页头按状态切换小德表情。 加权轮询、健康检查、故障切换，以及 Filter 感知的代理包装层。 连接池核心：并发控制、自动归还、空闲驱逐、KeepAlive 与 PSCache 容器。 AST 级 SQL 防火墙与 SQL 执行统计，通过 Filter 链挂进连接池。 Filter trait、默认空实现、责任链与管理器，负责生命周期事件分发。 词法器、递归下降 Parser、AST、格式化与 Schema 提取。 错误、配置、30 种方言枚举，以及 SQL 检测、字符串、加密与时间工具。 守夜不眠对应监控统计，德鲁伊兜帽对应安全防护，立于连接池之上对应连接池本身。它的 12 种表情会出现在控制台页头，按当前状态自动切换。 Druid-Rust 由 艾瑞可erik 维护。如果这个项目对你有帮助，可以请开发者喝杯咖啡。 支付宝 微信支付

sections.heading: 能力不是一次写完的
sections.text: 从最初的十块拼图，到 Filter 真正接入连接池，再到小德的表情进入控制台。每一步都对应一次版本。 以连接池为核心，通过 Filter 责任链向外扩展。每块能力都可以单独引入。 异步连接池 Semaphore 精确控制并发，PoolGuard 在 drop 时自动归还，后台任务负责驱逐与保活。 预热 获取超时 借还验证 KeepAlive PSCache 容器 SQL 解析引擎 从词法器到递归下降 Parser，再到 AST 与 Schema 提取，为防火墙和格式化提供结构化输入。 80+ Token 22 种表达式 30 种方言 SchemaVisitor SQL 防火墙 基于 AST 检查危险操作、函数与语句结构。解析失败或类型无法识别时默认拒绝。 强制 WHERE 多语句拦截 文件写入拦截 512 条缓存 监控统计 记录每条 SQL 的次数、耗时、最大耗时与错误，慢 SQL 自动告警，指标无锁累加。 慢 SQL PoolMetrics StatFilter Prometheus 对接 高可用与代理 加权轮询多数据源，异步健康检查，连续失败或成功达到阈值才切换，避免抖动。 故障切换 健康检查 mark_down ProxyStatement Web 控制台 axum 驱动的监控页面与 JSON 接口，支持 Bearer token，页头根据状态切换小德表情。 /druid/stat.json /druid/sql.json 慢 SQL 接口 12 种表情 这里只讲每个版本改变了什么。逐条修复记录在版本日志里。 首次发布 10 个 crate：异步连接池、SQL 解析器、防火墙、统计、高可用与控制台。61 项测试起步。 加入 CTE/WITH 支持，修复 KeepAlive 的 TOCTOU 问题，补齐驱逐、创建与销毁路径的指标，防火墙覆盖更多 SQL 子句。 补上 CI、LICENSE、CHANGELOG 与 CONTRIBUTING，10 个子 crate 补齐元数据，清理未使用的依赖。 项目宠物「小德」进入 README 与控制台，架构图、功能图、生命周期图一并补齐，测试数从 61 增长到 231。 深度审查发现 SQL 防火墙与统计在连接池路径上从未执行。本版引入构造期注入与 PoolGuard 的 execute/query 入口，防火墙改为默认 fail-closed，并修复 11 项安全与并发缺陷。 修掉三处配置 Debug 的口令脱敏边界，把吉祥物资产移入 crate 内部解决打包失败；druid-wall 与 druid-console 首次发布到 crates.io。 12 种宠物表情进入控制台并按状态切换，代理层补齐语句生命周期钩子，鉴权下 favicon 不再 401，测试数达到 431。 有些限制是刻意的安全取舍，已经在代码与文档中标注。 查看完整版本日志 →

sections.heading: 每次发版 都写清楚改了什么
sections.text: 功能、修复、破坏性变更与安全边界，按版本归档。完整原文见仓库 CHANGELOG.md。 功能版：宠物表情形态正式进入 druid-console，同时修复代理层语句钩子、鉴权下的 favicon 加载与 stable 工具链的 clippy 失败。测试总数 428 到 431。 12 个表情 SVG 移入 druid-console/assets/pet-expressions/ 并随 crate 发布，新增 GET /druid/pet/<name>.svg 路由。 监控页头按状态自动切换表情：SQL 错误对应愤怒，慢 SQL 对应沮丧，池用满对应敲打，尚无执行对应卖萌，正常对应微笑。 防漂移测试保证 docs 与 crate 内副本字节一致，新增 GitHub Social Preview 图。 代理层补齐 statement_created、statement_error、statement_closed，执行失败或被拦截时不再漏记错误。 鉴权开启后，/druid/mascot.svg 与 /druid/pet/<name>.svg 不再要求 Bearer token，favicon 不会 401。 WallProvider::new(..., 0) 现在真正禁用缓存，与 PSCache 的 0=禁用语义一致。 适配 Rust 1.99 stable 的 clippy，迁移到 Atomic::try_update。 1.3.0 发布当日的补丁。对抗验证又挖出 5 组配置 Debug 明文口令泄漏与 1 个打包缺陷。 userinfo 旁边的参数值：改为从右往左取第一个不在参数值里的 @，豁免只作用于分隔符本身。 scheme 段：按 SAFE_SCHEME_LABELS 白名单逐段比对，未知标签整段打码。 键名标签：值是否打码仍用子串判断，键名能否回显改为精确白名单。 收敛为一条原则：每一段都要判定，判定范围等于作用范围。 吉祥物资产移入 crate 目录，修复 cargo package 缺文件导致的编译失败，并加防漂移测试。 druid-wall 与 druid-console 首次发布到 crates.io。 10 个 crate 补 readme 字段，crates.io 页面显示项目 README。 深度审查与三轮对抗验证后的集中修复。核心结论：1.2.0 的 SQL 防火墙与统计在连接池路径上从不执行，因为 Filter 无处挂载，PoolGuard 只暴露裸连接。 防火墙默认 fail-closed：解析失败或语句类型无法识别的 SQL 一律拒绝。逃生开关为 deny_unparsable = false。 DruidConfig::filters 非空时 init() 返回错误，请改用 DruidDataSource::with_filters(...)。 DruidError 加 #[non_exhaustive]，下游穷尽 match 需要补 _ =>。 max_lifetime_ms 改为按物理连接创建时刻判定，原先按最近使用时刻，热点连接下实际从未生效。 非法配置如 initial_size > max_active 现在由 DruidConfig::validate() 在 init 时报错。 druid-ha 删除无消费者的 NodeStatus::Testing；substitute_params 标记 deprecated，请改用 substitute_params_mysql。 构造期注入：with_filters() 与 with_chain()，链在包装为 Arc 前配置完成，无注册竞态。 PoolGuard::execute() 与 query()：唯一会让 SQL 流经 Filter 链的入口，connection() 保留为绕过 Filter 的逃生通道。 补齐 5 个定义了却从不 dispatch 的生命周期钩子，新增 impl Filter for Arc<T>。 控制台 token 鉴权、常量时间比较、Cache-Control: no-store、SQL 接口分页。 防火墙 deny_unparsable、事务控制语句安全通道、更多 DenyOperation 归类。 解析器支持 LIMIT offset, count、@var 与 EXPLAIN。 高可用新增失败/成功阈值、探测超时与可停止的健康检查循环。 防火墙解析失败只告警就放行、quick_check 的 deny 结果被丢弃，8 条绕过全部封堵。 函数黑名单不递归参数，COALESCE(SLEEP(5),0) 可绕过，现递归遍历。 CREATE TABLE ... sections.heading: 把连接池装进你的项目
sections.text: Druid-Rust 是一个 Rust workspace，核心 crate 可以单独引入，也可以按需组合防火墙、统计与控制台。 Rust stable 工具链，edition 2021。 tokio 异步运行时，示例使用 features = ["full"]。 一个可用的数据库，以及实现 Driver 与 Connection trait 的驱动适配层。项目不内置数据库驱动。 如果你只需要 SQL 解析器或防火墙，可以单独引入对应 crate，不必使用连接池。 在 Cargo.toml 中加入需要的 crate。最小组合是 druid-core 加 druid-pool。 # 版本统一为 1.4 [dependencies] druid-core = "1.4" druid-pool = "1.4" druid-wall = "1.4" druid-stat = "1.4" tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] } 也可以直接用 cargo add： cargo add druid-core druid-pool druid-wall druid-stat cargo add tokio --features full 创建数据源、预热连接、借出一个 guard，再让它自动归还。示例里的 your_driver 需要替换成你的驱动实现。 use druid_core::DruidConfig; use druid_pool::DruidDataSource; #[tokio::main] async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> { let mut config = DruidConfig::new( "mysql://localhost:3306/mydb", "root", "password", ); config.initial_size = 5; config.max_active = 20; config.min_idle = 3; // your_driver 需要实现 druid_pool::Driver let ds = DruidDataSource::new(your_driver, config); ds.init().await?; let guard = ds.get_connection().await?; // 通过 guard.execute() / guard.query() 执行 SQL，Filter 才会生效 drop(guard); // 自动归还 ds.close().await?; Ok(()) } 需要参与开发或使用未发布改动时，可以直接构建整个 workspace。 git clone https://github.com/erikwang2013/druid-rust.git cd druid-rust cargo build --release cargo test --workspace cargo run --example basic Release 构建启用了 LTO、codegen-units = 1 与 opt-level = 3。 先做一次快速编译检查，再确认依赖树里出现了目标 crate。 cargo check cargo tree -p druid-pool 运行测试时，完整 workspace 应显示 431 项通过。测试分布可在 README 的「开发与测试」章节查看。 DruidConfig::filters 从未接线。请改用 DruidDataSource::with_filters(driver, config, filters)，在构造期注入 Filter 链。 防火墙默认 fail-closed，解析器尚未支持的语法会被拒绝，例如 UNION、SHOW、USE、SET、EXPLAIN FORMAT=TREE。确认风险后再显式设置 deny_unparsable = false。 使用 start_server_with_token() 后，数据与页面端点需要 Authorization: Bearer <token>。静态宠物资源仍然公开，便于浏览器加载 favicon。 本项目定义了自己的异步 Driver 与 Connection trait，不依赖 JDBC，也不内置 ORM。你需要写一层驱动适配，把数据库客户端接到这两个 trait 上。 装好之后，从连接池、防火墙、监控与控制台四个场景开始。 阅读使用说明 → 参考 README 原文 →

title: 使用说明 · Druid-Rust
description: Druid-Rust 使用说明：创建数据源、执行 SQL、防火墙、监控、控制台、高可用与自定义 Filter。

sections.heading: 连接池、防火墙与监控 按场景接入
sections.text: 所有示例假设 config 已由 DruidConfig 创建，your_driver 是实现了 Driver 的适配层。 DruidConfig 保存连接信息与池参数。设置预热、最小空闲与最大活跃数后，调用 init() 建立初始连接。 use druid_core::DruidConfig; use druid_pool::DruidDataSource; let mut config = DruidConfig::new( "mysql://localhost:3306/mydb", "root", "password", ); config.initial_size = 5; config.min_idle = 3; config.max_active = 20; config.max_wait_ms = 3_000; let ds = DruidDataSource::new(your_driver, config); ds.init().await?; 借出的 PoolGuard 在 drop 时自动归还，panic 也不会泄漏连接。SQL 走 execute() 或 query()，Filter 链才会被调用。 let guard = ds.get_connection().await?; let affected = guard.execute( "UPDATE users SET active = 1 WHERE id = 42", ).await?; drop(guard); // 自动归还，无需显式释放 Filter 在构造期注入。链在包装为 Arc 前完成配置，运行期只读，不存在注册竞态。 use druid_pool::DruidDataSource; use druid_wall::{WallConfig, WallFilter}; let ds = DruidDataSource::with_filters( your_driver, config, vec![Box::new(WallFilter::new(WallConfig { update_delete_require_where: true, deny_functions: vec!["SLEEP".into(), "BENCHMARK".into()], ..Default::default() }))], ); ds.init().await?; // SQL 必须走 guard.execute() / query()，Filter 才会被调用 let affected = guard.execute( "DELETE FROM t WHERE id = 1", ).await?; 把 Arc<StatFilter> 传进 Filter 链，同时保留句柄供链外读取。绑定池内权威指标后，控制台的 active/idle 直接读池计数。 use druid_pool::DruidDataSource; use druid_stat::StatFilter; use std::sync::Arc; let stat = Arc::new(StatFilter::new("mydb", 1000)); // 1000ms 慢 SQL 阈值 let ds = DruidDataSource::with_filters( your_driver, config, vec![Box::new(stat.clone())], ); ds.init().await?; stat.bind_metrics(ds.metrics_arc()); let sql_stats = stat.get_sql_stats(); // 按耗时排序 let slow_sql = stat.get_slow_sql(); // 超过阈值 let ds_stat = stat.get_datasource_stat(); // 连接池概览 println!("执行次数: {}, 慢SQL: {}", ds_stat.execute_count, slow_sql.len()); SQL 统计表默认上限 1000 条，按总耗时淘汰最冷条目。动态 SQL 较多时可用 StatFilter::with_max_sql_size(n) 调整。 控制台会暴露 SQL 原文，生产环境必须设置 token，或者只绑定回环地址。 use druid_console; use std::sync::Arc; let stat = Arc::new(StatFilter::new("app-db", 500)); tokio::spawn(async { druid_console::start_server_with_token( stat, "127.0.0.1:9090", Some("my-secret".into()), ) .await .unwrap(); }); // 浏览器访问 http://127.0.0.1:9090/druid/index.html // 请求需带 Authorization: Bearer my-secret 静态宠物资源 /druid/mascot.svg 与 /druid/pet/<name>.svg 不要求鉴权，因为它们不包含 SQL 或统计数据。 加权轮询多个数据源，健康检查连续失败或成功达到阈值才切换，避免抖动。 use druid_ha::HighAvailableDataSource; use std::time::Duration; let mut ha = HighAvailableDataSource::new(); ha.add_node("master", master_ds, 2); // 权重 2 ha.add_node("slave-1", slave1_ds, 1); ha.add_node("slave-2", slave2_ds, 1); ha.set_check_interval(Duration::from_secs(30)); let ds = ha.get_datasource().await?; ha.mark_down("master"); // 手动故障切换 ha.mark_up("master"); // 恢复 let ha = std::sync::Arc::new(ha); let _handle = ha.spawn_health_check_loop(); 实现 Filter trait 的钩子即可插入自己的逻辑，不需要继承任何基类。 use druid_filter::{Filter, FilterContext}; use druid_core::DruidError; struct MyLogFilter; impl Filter for MyLogFilter { fn name(&self) -> &'static str { "my-log" } fn connection_borrowed(&self, ctx: &FilterContext, wait_ms: u64) { tracing::info!("conn borrowed: wait={}ms", wait_ms); sections.text: DruidConfig 保存连接信息与池参数。设置预热、最小空闲与最大活跃数后，调用 init() 建立初始连接。 use druid_core::DruidConfig; use druid_pool::DruidDataSource; let mut config = DruidConfig::new( "mysql://localhost:3306/mydb", "root", "password", ); config.initial_size = 5; config.min_idle = 3; config.max_active = 20; config.max_wait_ms = 3_000; let ds = DruidDataSource::new(your_driver, config); ds.init().await?;

sections.heading: 执行 SQL
sections.text: 借出的 PoolGuard 在 drop 时自动归还，panic 也不会泄漏连接。SQL 走 execute() 或 query()，Filter 链才会被调用。 let guard = ds.get_connection().await?; let affected = guard.execute( "UPDATE users SET active = 1 WHERE id = 42", ).await?; drop(guard); // 自动归还，无需显式释放

sections.heading: SQL 防火墙
sections.text: Filter 在构造期注入。链在包装为 Arc 前完成配置，运行期只读，不存在注册竞态。 use druid_pool::DruidDataSource; use druid_wall::{WallConfig, WallFilter}; let ds = DruidDataSource::with_filters( your_driver, config, vec![Box::new(WallFilter::new(WallConfig { update_delete_require_where: true, deny_functions: vec!["SLEEP".into(), "BENCHMARK".into()], ..Default::default() }))], ); ds.init().await?; // SQL 必须走 guard.execute() / query()，Filter 才会被调用 let affected = guard.execute( "DELETE FROM t WHERE id = 1", ).await?;

sections.text: 把 Arc<StatFilter> 传进 Filter 链，同时保留句柄供链外读取。绑定池内权威指标后，控制台的 active/idle 直接读池计数。 use druid_pool::DruidDataSource; use druid_stat::StatFilter; use std::sync::Arc; let stat = Arc::new(StatFilter::new("mydb", 1000)); // 1000ms 慢 SQL 阈值 let ds = DruidDataSource::with_filters( your_driver, config, vec![Box::new(stat.clone())], ); ds.init().await?; stat.bind_metrics(ds.metrics_arc()); let sql_stats = stat.get_sql_stats(); // 按耗时排序 let slow_sql = stat.get_slow_sql(); // 超过阈值 let ds_stat = stat.get_datasource_stat(); // 连接池概览 println!("执行次数: {}, 慢SQL: {}", ds_stat.execute_count, slow_sql.len()); SQL 统计表默认上限 1000 条，按总耗时淘汰最冷条目。动态 SQL 较多时可用 StatFilter::with_max_sql_size(n) 调整。

sections.heading: Web 控制台
sections.text: 控制台会暴露 SQL 原文，生产环境必须设置 token，或者只绑定回环地址。 use druid_console; use std::sync::Arc; let stat = Arc::new(StatFilter::new("app-db", 500)); tokio::spawn(async { druid_console::start_server_with_token( stat, "127.0.0.1:9090", Some("my-secret".into()), ) .await .unwrap(); }); // 浏览器访问 http://127.0.0.1:9090/druid/index.html // 请求需带 Authorization: Bearer my-secret 静态宠物资源 /druid/mascot.svg 与 /druid/pet/<name>.svg 不要求鉴权，因为它们不包含 SQL 或统计数据。

sections.heading: Bringing Druid's capabilities into async Rust
sections.text: A Rust port of Alibaba Druid, rebuilt around traits and tokio while keeping the core ideas. Druid-Rust rewrites the connection pooling, SQL parsing, firewall and monitoring ideas proven in the Java ecosystem as a set of Rust crates. No JVM, no DI container and no ORM wrapper: connections, SQL and metrics are exposed through explicit structs and traits. The project is split into ten crates. Use druid-pool on its own for pooling, or put druid-wall and druid-stat into the Filter chain for security and observability. Code is Apache-2.0. The mascot and visual assets are copyright the author and require a commercial license for commercial use. Not a line-by-line translation of Java class hierarchy: keep the problem, choose the Rust solution. Tokio-based async I/O, Semaphore concurrency control, and background eviction and KeepAlive tasks. The Java class hierarchy becomes trait and struct composition. The Filter trait exposes lifecycle hooks with no-op defaults. The DbType enum covers 30 database dialects, while SQL statements and expressions are algebraic data types. AOT-compiled native code, PoolGuard RAII return, no JIT warmup and no runtime container. Dependencies point one way, and every connection state has a clear owner. Each layer has one job. Lower layers never need to know that upper layers exist. axum HTTP dashboard and JSON endpoints, with Xiao De changing expression by pool status. Weighted round-robin, health checks, failover and Filter-aware proxy wrappers. Pool core: concurrency control, automatic return, idle eviction, KeepAlive and PSCache containers. AST-level SQL firewall and SQL execution statistics, attached through the Filter chain. Filter trait, no-op adapter, responsibility chain and manager for lifecycle events. Lexer, recursive-descent parser, AST, formatter and schema visitor. Errors, configuration and the 30-dialect enum, plus SQL detection, strings, crypto and time helpers. Never sleeping maps to monitoring, the druid hood maps to security, and standing on the pool maps to pooling itself. Its 12 expressions appear in the console header and switch with the current state. Druid-Rust is maintained by Erik. If the project helps you, you can buy the developer a coffee. Alipay WeChat Pay

sections.heading: Every release, written down
sections.text: Features, fixes, breaking changes and security boundaries, grouped by version. The full source is CHANGELOG.md. Feature release: pet expression forms enter druid-console, alongside fixes for proxy statement hooks, authenticated favicon loading and clippy on the current stable toolchain. Tests grow from 428 to 431. 12 expression SVGs move into druid-console/assets/pet-expressions/ and ship with the crate. New GET /druid/pet/<name>.svg route. The console header switches expression by state: SQL error to angry, slow SQL to depressed, pool exhausted to knocking, no queries yet to cute, healthy to smile. A drift test keeps docs and crate copies byte-identical. Added a GitHub Social Preview image. The proxy layer now dispatches statement_created, statement_error and statement_closed, so failed or blocked statements are counted. With authentication enabled, /druid/mascot.svg and /druid/pet/<name>.svg no longer require a Bearer token, so the favicon does not return 401. WallProvider::new(..., 0) truly disables caching, matching the PSCache zero-means-disabled semantics. Clippy fixes for Rust 1.99 stable, including the move to Atomic::try_update. A same-day patch after adversarial validation found five more plaintext credential leaks in config Debug output and one packaging defect. Parameter values next to userinfo: pick the first @ from the right that is not inside a value, and apply the exemption only to the separator. Scheme segment: compare against the SAFE_SCHEME_LABELS allowlist; unknown labels are redacted entirely. Key labels: values still use substring matching in the fail-closed direction, but key names can only echo from an exact allowlist. One rule: every segment is judged, and the judging scope equals the applied scope. Mascot assets move into the crate, fixing cargo package failures, with a drift test. druid-wall and druid-console are published to crates.io for the first time. All ten crates get readme metadata so crates.io shows the project README. A deep review and three rounds of adversarial validation. The core finding: in 1.2.0 the SQL firewall and statistics never ran on the pool path, because filters had nowhere to attach and PoolGuard exposed only the raw connection. The firewall is fail-closed by default: unparsable or unrecognized statements are rejected. Escape hatch: deny_unparsable = false. DruidConfig::filters is not wired; a non-empty value makes init() fail. Use DruidDataSource::with_filters(...). DruidError is #[non_exhaustive]; downstream exhaustive matches need a _ => arm. max_lifetime_ms is now judged by physical creation time. The old last-used time made it ineffective for hot connections. Invalid configs such as initial_size > max_active fail at init through DruidConfig::validate(). druid-ha removes the unused NodeStatus::Testing. substitute_params is deprecated in favor of substitute_params_mysql. Construction-time injection: with_filters() and with_chain(), configured before the chain is wrapped in Arc. PoolGuard::execute() and query(): the only path where SQL reaches the Filter chain. connection() remains the escape hatch. Five lifecycle hooks that were defined but never dispatched are wired, plus impl Filter for Arc<T>. Console token authentication, constant-time comparison, Cache-Control: no-store and pagination. Wall deny_unparsable, a transaction-control safe channel, and broader DenyOperation classification. Parser support for LIMIT offset, count, @var and EXPLAIN. HA failure/success thresholds, probe timeouts and a stoppable health-check loop. The firewall logged and allowed on parse failure, and quick_check discard denial results. Eight bypasses closed. The function denylist did not recurse into arguments, so COALESCE(SLEEP(5),0) slipped through. It now recurses. CREATE TABLE ... DEFAULT (RAND()) bypass reproduced on real databases and closed. deny_keywords was blinded by quoting twice. Matching text is rebuilt from the lexer token stream. substitute_params backslash injection. Added a MySQL-safe variant. Plaintext credentials in config Debug output. Redaction now works segment by segment. The console exposed raw SQL without authentication. Added a token and loopback guidance. Crypto did not enable the zeroize features, so key material was not cleared on drop. Cancellation safety: a pending guard is created early, so cancellation does not leak a physical connection. Fixed connections being created after close, distorted return-validation counts, and close not waking waiters. KeepAlive no longer closes connections in use, and shares state semantics with the borrow path. Fixed permits released before the connection returned, which could exceed max_active. DruidDataSource now has Drop, so background tasks and idle connections do not leak. HA fixes for stuck nodes, no per-probe timeout, one-failure death, and an unstoppable loop. Statistics fixes for unbounded SQL tables, drifting active/idle counts and printing under lock. Parser fixes for NOT precedence, recursive depth, silent truncation and treating every -- as a comment. Formatter fixes for string escaping, lost CREATE TABLE constraints, missing parentheses and literal JOIN output. Xiao De enters the README and console. /druid/mascot.svg also serves as the site favicon. Architecture, feature and connection-lifecycle diagrams, plus mascot and lifecycle sections in the README. The console header inlines the mascot without copying the asset. CI green: full rustfmt and clippy cleanup. Release workflow uses gh release create --target, fixing repeated failures on runners without git identity. Test badges and distribution tables update to the measured 231 tests. CI workflow with check, test, clippy and fmt jobs. LICENSE, CHANGELOG, CONTRIBUTING and payment QR codes in the README. All ten crates get description, keywords and category metadata. Removed unused sqlx, rand and tracing-subscriber dependencies. CTE/WITH support in the parser, AST, formatter and visitor. KeepAlive eviction uses an (id, last_used_at) double condition to fix TOCTOU. Cache-hit, waiting, create and destroy counters are complete. The firewall covers GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT, OFFSET and subqueries. PoolGuard is generic over Driver for return validation, and DROP parsing advances correctly. Removed the dead NationalString and Whitespace tokens. First release with ten crates. Semaphore-based async pool with eviction, KeepAlive and PSCache. SQL lexer, recursive-descent parser and 30 database dialects. AST-level SQL firewall, slow SQL detection and weighted round-robin HA. axum console, Filter chain architecture and AES-256-GCM helpers. 61 unit and integration tests. Full source: CHANGELOG.md →

Tests grow from 428 to 431. 12 expression SVGs move into druid-console/assets/pet-expressions/ and ship with the crate. New GET /druid/pet/<name>.svg route. The console header switches expression by state: SQL error to angry, slow SQL to depressed, pool exhausted to knocking, no queries yet to cute, healthy to smile. A drift test keeps docs and crate copies byte-identical. Added a GitHub Social Preview image. The proxy layer now dispatches statement_created, statement_error and statement_closed, so failed or blocked statements are counted. With authentication enabled, /druid/mascot.svg and /druid/pet/<name>.svg no longer require a Bearer token, so the favicon does not return 401. WallProvider::new(..., 0) truly disables caching, matching the PSCache zero-means-disabled semantics. Clippy fixes for Rust 1.99 stable, including the move to Atomic::try_update.

sections.heading: v1.3.1 2026-10-01 Security Fixed
sections.text: A same-day patch after adversarial validation found five more plaintext credential leaks in config Debug output and one packaging defect. Parameter values next to userinfo: pick the first @ from the right that is not inside a value, and apply the exemption only to the separator. Scheme segment: compare against the SAFE_SCHEME_LABELS allowlist; unknown labels are redacted entirely. Key labels: values still use substring matching in the fail-closed direction, but key names can only echo from an exact allowlist. One rule: every segment is judged, and the judging scope equals the applied scope. Mascot assets move into the crate, fixing cargo package failures, with a drift test. druid-wall and druid-console are published to crates.io for the first time. All ten crates get readme metadata so crates.io shows the project README.

sections.heading: v1.3.0 2026-10-01 Breaking Security
sections.text: A deep review and three rounds of adversarial validation. The core finding: in 1.2.0 the SQL firewall and statistics never ran on the pool path, because filters had nowhere to attach and PoolGuard exposed only the raw connection. The firewall is fail-closed by default: unparsable or unrecognized statements are rejected. Escape hatch: deny_unparsable = false. DruidConfig::filters is not wired; a non-empty value makes init() fail. Use DruidDataSource::with_filters(...). DruidError is #[non_exhaustive]; downstream exhaustive matches need a _ => arm. max_lifetime_ms is now judged by physical creation time. The old last-used time made it ineffective for hot connections. Invalid configs such as initial_size > max_active fail at init through DruidConfig::validate(). druid-ha removes the unused NodeStatus::Testing. substitute_params is deprecated in favor of substitute_params_mysql. Construction-time injection: with_filters() and with_chain(), configured before the chain is wrapped in Arc. PoolGuard::execute() and query(): the only path where SQL reaches the Filter chain. connection() remains the escape hatch. Five lifecycle hooks that were defined but never dispatched are wired, plus impl Filter for Arc<T>. Console token authentication, constant-time comparison, Cache-Control: no-store and pagination. Wall deny_unparsable, a transaction-control safe channel, and broader DenyOperation classification. Parser support for LIMIT offset, count, @var and EXPLAIN. HA failure/success thresholds, probe timeouts and a stoppable health-check loop. The firewall logged and allowed on parse failure, and quick_check discard denial results. Eight bypasses closed. The function denylist did not recurse into arguments, so COALESCE(SLEEP(5),0) slipped through. It now recurses. CREATE TABLE ... DEFAULT (RAND()) bypass reproduced on real databases and closed. deny_keywords was blinded by quoting twice. Matching text is rebuilt from the lexer token stream. substitute_params backslash injection. Added a MySQL-safe variant. Plaintext credentials in config Debug output. Redaction now works segment by segment. The console exposed raw SQL without authentication. Added a token and loopback guidance. Crypto did not enable the zeroize features, so key material was not cleared on drop. Cancellation safety: a pending guard is created early, so cancellation does not leak a physical connection. Fixed connections being created after close, distorted return-validation counts, and close not waking waiters. KeepAlive no longer closes connections in use, and shares state semantics with the borrow path. Fixed permits released before the connection returned, which could exceed max_active. DruidDataSource now has Drop, so background tasks and idle connections do not leak. HA fixes for stuck nodes, no per-probe timeout, one-failure death, and an unstoppable loop. Statistics fixes for unbounded SQL tables, drifting active/idle counts and printing under lock. Parser fixes for NOT precedence, recursive depth, silent truncation and treating every -- as a comment. Formatter fixes for string escaping, lost CREATE TABLE constraints, missing parentheses and literal JOIN output.

label: Install
title: Install · Druid-Rust
description: Install Druid-Rust: requirements, Cargo dependencies, a minimal example, building from source and troubleshooting.

sections.heading: Put the pool into your project
sections.text: Druid-Rust is a Rust workspace. Use the core crate alone, or combine pooling, firewall, statistics and the console. Rust stable, edition 2021. The tokio async runtime. Examples use features = ["full"]. A database and a driver adapter implementing the Driver and Connection traits. The project does not bundle a database driver. If you only need the SQL parser or firewall, add that crate alone and skip the pool. Add the crates you need to Cargo.toml. The minimal combination is druid-core plus druid-pool. # Version 1.4 [dependencies] druid-core = "1.4" druid-pool = "1.4" druid-wall = "1.4" druid-stat = "1.4" tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] } Or use cargo add: cargo add druid-core druid-pool druid-wall druid-stat cargo add tokio --features full Create a data source, warm up connections, borrow a guard and let drop return it. Replace your_driver with your driver implementation. use druid_core::DruidConfig; use druid_pool::DruidDataSource; #[tokio::main] async fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> { let mut config = DruidConfig::new( "mysql://localhost:3306/mydb", "root", "password", ); config.initial_size = 5; config.max_active = 20; config.min_idle = 3; // your_driver must implement druid_pool::Driver let ds = DruidDataSource::new(your_driver, config); ds.init().await?; let guard = ds.get_connection().await?; // Use guard.execute() / guard.query() so filters run drop(guard); // returned automatically ds.close().await?; Ok(()) } Build the whole workspace when developing or when you need unreleased changes. git clone https://github.com/erikwang2013/druid-rust.git cd druid-rust cargo build --release cargo test --workspace cargo run --example basic Release builds enable LTO, codegen-units = 1 and opt-level = 3. Run a quick compile check, then confirm the target crate is in the dependency tree. cargo check cargo tree -p druid-pool The full workspace test run should report 431 passing tests. DruidConfig::filters is not wired. Use DruidDataSource::with_filters(driver, config, filters) to attach the chain at construction time. The firewall is fail-closed, so syntax the parser does not yet support is rejected, including UNION, SHOW, USE, SET and EXPLAIN FORMAT=TREE. Set deny_unparsable = false only after reviewing the risk. With start_server_with_token(), data and page endpoints require Authorization: Bearer <token>. Static pet assets stay public so the browser can load the favicon. The project defines its own async Driver and Connection traits and does not bundle an ORM. Write a small adapter from your database client to those traits. Once installed, start with the pool, firewall, monitoring and console scenarios. Read the usage guide → Read the full README →

label: Usage
title: Usage · Druid-Rust
description: Druid-Rust usage: create a data source, run SQL, attach the firewall, monitor, open the console, configure HA and write custom filters.

sections.heading: Pool, firewall and monitoring by scenario
sections.text: The examples assume config is a DruidConfig and your_driver is an adapter implementing Driver. DruidConfig holds the connection details and pool parameters. Set warm-up, minimum idle and maximum active, then call init() to build the initial connections. use druid_core::DruidConfig; use druid_pool::DruidDataSource; let mut config = DruidConfig::new( "mysql://localhost:3306/mydb", "root", "password", ); config.initial_size = 5; config.min_idle = 3; config.max_active = 20; config.max_wait_ms = 3_000; let ds = DruidDataSource::new(your_driver, config); ds.init().await?; A borrowed PoolGuard returns automatically on drop, even during a panic. Use execute() or query() so the Filter chain runs. let guard = ds.get_connection().await?; let affected = guard.execute( "UPDATE users SET active = 1 WHERE id = 42", ).await?; drop(guard); // returned automatically Filters are injected at construction time. The chain is configured before it is wrapped in Arc, so there is no registration race. use druid_pool::DruidDataSource; use druid_wall::{WallConfig, WallFilter}; let ds = DruidDataSource::with_filters( your_driver, config, vec![Box::new(WallFilter::new(WallConfig { update_delete_require_where: true, deny_functions: vec!["SLEEP".into(), "BENCHMARK".into()], ..Default::default() }))], ); ds.init().await?; // SQL must go through guard.execute() / query() for filters to run let affected = guard.execute( "DELETE FROM t WHERE id = 1", ).await?; Pass an Arc<StatFilter> into the chain and keep the handle for reads. Bind the pool metrics so the console reads authoritative active and idle counts. use druid_pool::DruidDataSource; use druid_stat::StatFilter; use std::sync::Arc; let stat = Arc::new(StatFilter::new("mydb", 1000)); // 1000ms slow SQL threshold let ds = DruidDataSource::with_filters( your_driver, config, vec![Box::new(stat.clone())], ); ds.init().await?; stat.bind_metrics(ds.metrics_arc()); let sql_stats = stat.get_sql_stats(); // sorted by latency let slow_sql = stat.get_slow_sql(); // above the threshold let ds_stat = stat.get_datasource_stat(); // pool overview println!("executions: {}, slow SQL: {}", ds_stat.execute_count, slow_sql.len()); The SQL statistics table holds 1000 entries by default and evicts the coldest by total latency. Use StatFilter::with_max_sql_size(n) for dynamic SQL workloads. The console exposes raw SQL, so set a token in production or bind it to loopback only. use druid_console; use std::sync::Arc; let stat = Arc::new(StatFilter::new("app-db", 500)); tokio::spawn(async { druid_console::start_server_with_token( stat, "127.0.0.1:9090", Some("my-secret".into()), ) .await .unwrap(); }); // Open http://127.0.0.1:9090/druid/index.html // Requests need Authorization: Bearer my-secret The static pet assets /druid/mascot.svg and /druid/pet/<name>.svg do not require auth because they contain no SQL or statistics. Weighted round-robin across data sources. Failover only happens after a failure or success threshold is reached, which avoids flapping. use druid_ha::HighAvailableDataSource; use std::time::Duration; let mut ha = HighAvailableDataSource::new(); ha.add_node("master", master_ds, 2); // weight 2 ha.add_node("slave-1", slave1_ds, 1); ha.add_node("slave-2", slave2_ds, 1); ha.set_check_interval(Duration::from_secs(30)); let ds = ha.get_datasource().await?; ha.mark_down("master"); // manual failover ha.mark_up("master"); // recover let ha = std::sync::Arc::new(ha); let _handle = ha.spawn_health_check_loop(); Implement the Filter trait hooks you need. There is no base class to inherit. use druid_filter::{Filter, FilterContext}; use druid_core::DruidError; struct MyLogFilter; impl Filter for MyLogFilter { fn name(&self) -> &'static str { "my-log" } fn connection_borrowed(&self, ctx: &FilterContext, wait_ms: u64) { tracing::info!("conn borrowed: wait={}ms", wait_ms); } fn statement_execute_before(&self, ctx: &FilterContext) -> Result<(), DruidError> { if let Some(sql) = &ctx.sql { tracing::debug!("executing: {}", sql); } Ok(()) } fn statement_execute_after(&self, ctx: &FilterContext, elapsed_ms: u64, rows: u64) { tracing::info!("executed in {}ms, {} rows", elapsed_ms, rows); } Common pool parameters are below. Expand for the full field list. initial_size 0 Connections created at init min_idle 0 Minimum idle connections max_active 8 Maximum active connections max_wait_ms 0 Borrow timeout, 0 means unlimited test_on_borrow true Validate when borrowed keep_alive false Periodic background validation max_evictable_idle_time_ms 1800000 Minimum idle lifetime, 30 minutes max_lifetime_ms 0 Absolute lifetime by creation time url none Database connection URL username / password none Connection credentials initial_size 0 Connections created at init min_idle 0 Minimum idle connections max_active 8 Maximum active connections max_wait_ms 0 Borrow timeout, 0 means unlimited time_between_eviction_runs_ms 60000 Eviction check interval min_evictable_idle_time_ms 1800000 Minimum idle lifetime max_evictable_idle_time_ms 25200000 Maximum idle lifetime max_lifetime_ms 0 Absolute lifetime by creation time test_on_borrow true Validate when borrowed test_on_return false Validate when returned test_while_idle false Validate while idle, not wired validation_query None Validation SQL, not wired validation_query_timeout_secs 0 Validation timeout, 0 means none keep_alive false Enable KeepAlive keep_alive_between_time_ms 120000 KeepAlive interval filters [] Not wired; a non-empty value fails init, use with_filters connect_timeout_secs 30 Connect timeout socket_timeout_secs 30 Socket timeout, not wired enabled true Enable the firewall deny_operations Truncate, DropTable, AlterTable Denied operations deny_functions SLEEP, BENCHMARK, LOAD_FILE Denied functions deny_keywords [] Denied keywords deny_schemas [] Denied schemas max_sql_length 8192 Maximum SQL length allow_multi_statements false Allow multi-statement SQL update_delete_require_where true Require WHERE on UPDATE/DELETE select_into_outfile_allow false Allow SELECT INTO OUTFILE deny_unparsable true Reject unparsable or unknown statements Do not expose the console without authentication in production. Raw SQL may contain literals and sensitive values. Send application SQL through guard.execute() and guard.query(); otherwise the firewall and statistics are bypassed. The firewall is fail-closed by default. Review the parser gaps before disabling deny_unparsable. DruidConfig Debug output redacts credentials segment by segment, but do not print whole config objects to production logs. The crypto helpers do not implement a KDF. Do not use a password directly as a key. Read the full README →
